title: Hardware Automation Schedule
description: Archived OpenDev 2020 Hardware Automation programme, with sessions on provisioning, bare metal, networking and security, and links to discussion notes.
body:
Watch the Videos

 

Schedule of Events (time in UTC)

 

Master Etherpad for Hardware Automation event.

Day 1 - July 20
13:00-13:30   Kick-off
13:30-14:40   End-to-end hardware provisioning lifecycle for baremetal / cradle to grave for hypervisors
  • Vendor selection/intake/deployment to the facility floor
  • BIOS/Firmware Automation - Keeping it secure and detecting the attack

https://etherpad.opendev.org/p/OpenDev_HardwareAutomation_Day1
14:40-14:50   -- 10 min Break --
14:50-16:00  
  • Day-to-day consumption of hardware. Imaging, periodic health checks, etc
  • Power and thermal optimization automation

https://etherpad.opendev.org/p/OpenDev_HardwareAutomation_Day1

 

Day 2 - July 21
13:00-13:15   Kick-off
13:15-14:30   Consuming baremetal infrastructure to provision cloud based workloads
  • Hyperconverged
  • Autoscaled baremetal for cloud workload infrastructure, servers for serverless workloads

https://etherpad.opendev.org/p/OpenDev_HardwareAutomation_Day2
14:30-14:40   -- 10 min Break --
14:40-16:00   Consuming baremetal infrastructure to provision cloud based workloads
  • Preemptable baremetal: use cases for turning 'unused' baremetal into cloud infrastructure orchestrator; security
  • Redfish

https://etherpad.opendev.org/p/OpenDev_HardwareAutomation_Day2

 

Day 3 - July 22
13:00-13:15   Kick-off
13:15-14:25   Networking
  • Network: architectures, how are people automating, what are some of the operational cases being supported?

https://etherpad.opendev.org/p/OpenDev_HardwareAutomation_Day3
14:25-14:35   -- 10 min Break --
14:35-15:40   Network Security

https://etherpad.opendev.org/p/OpenDev_HardwareAutomation_Day3
15:40-16:00   Wrap-Up

https://etherpad.opendev.org/p/OpenDev_HardwareAutomation_WrapUp
